exemptions.text: from openai import OpenAI client = OpenAI(base_url="

/rerank \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "llmgateway/rerank", "query": "документ про маршрутизацию моделей", "documents": [ "Gateway models are called through a single API.", "Images are generated through /v1/images/generations.", "Usage statistics are grouped by day and month." ], "top_n": 2, "return_documents": true }'

/web/search \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "llmgateway/web-search", "query": "новости рынка LLM API", "max_results": 10, "language": "ru", "include_images": true }'

/web/research \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "llmgateway/web-research", "query": "сравнение API для web search", "language": "all", "max_results_per_lang": 10, "max_articles": 8, "output_language": "ru" }'

/tavily/search \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "llmgateway/web-search", "read_model": "llmgateway/web-read", "query": "LLM gateway web search", "max_results": 5, "include_raw_content": "markdown", "include_domains": ["example.com"], "include_images": true }'

/web/deep-research \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "llmgateway/web-deep-research", "query": "как устроены современные rerank модели", "max_words": 2500, "breadth": 4, "depth": 2, "concurrency": 6, "language": "ru", "format": "markdown", "image_generation": true }'

/decisions" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model":"llmgateway/jev-1.13","state":"A customer asks for a refund.","questions":{"refund_allowed":{"type":"noul","instructions":"Decide whether a refund is allowed.","criteria":{"true":"Refund is allowed","false":"Refund is not allowed"}}}}'

/decisions" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model":"llmgateway/jev-1.13","state":{"order_total":120,"currency":"USD"},"questions":{"risk_level":{"type":"choice","instructions":"Classify the risk level.","criteria":{"low":"Low risk","high":"High risk"}}}}'

/decisions" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model":"llmgateway/jev-1.13","state":["The package arrived late.","The customer requests compensation."],"questions":{"service_score":{"type":"score","instructions":"Score the service quality.","criteria":[1,2,3,4,5]}}}'

            </select>
